fightSong.title: Meter's Running
fightSong.lyrics: Get in, shut up, hold on tight / We're taking shortcuts through the night / Five boroughs, one fare, one fight / Cabbies running on green light!

stadium.name: The Meter
stadium.tradition: The Honk — pre-game, 78 yellow cabs circle the stadium honking in unison. If the decibel meter hits 120, it's a guaranteed win. It's hit 119 seven times.

fanCulture.description: They know every shortcut and every curse word. After sacks they yell 'YOU'RE WALKING!' They boo politely then aggressively negotiate. No one is from here but everyone claims it.
fanCulture.tailgate: Street carts, $2 hot dogs, arguments about the best route to the stadium.

rivalries.name: The Turnpike Toll
rivalries.narrative: 95 miles of pure hatred. They throw batteries, we charge surge pricing. Meet in Jersey to fight.

rivalries.name: The Chowder Run
rivalries.narrative: Boston thinks they're a real city. We think they're a large suburb with chowder.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: TOUCHDOWN! And that's on the meter!

cityFlavor: If you can make it here, you'll probably complain about it the whole time. Fast, loud, and always under construction.
